nodes.title: Application Client conformance and migration
nodes.summary: In progress under issue #152 as the campaign main effort. The existing writer resumed on 2026-10-08 on feature/client-conformance at preserved head 5fdd95c2c32cde08a6c936171b208bbf14f6677c and integrated current main. PR #161 was published on 2026-10-22 at 9cc23e67 and repaired to exact head 7505568cc57a10300f94a2f1e8ab5c88af5cea3b (tree f532f986). After Local findings L161-1 through L161-5, failed CI at 8bd3c330 and 2b8ade1d, where three Windows jobs rejected install authority as unsafe, and failed CI at ec8b88f7, where the Windows application_client_conformance test process exited with heap corruption, Local's source review approved the new head with no findings and the retained gpt-6-astra delta review approved it. Required CI passed at 7505568c, and the Watcher and Operator Station pre-merge consumer attestations approved that exact head; the formal consumer gate remains planned. The Application Client design inspection approved it with an inspector profile that differed from the task; the campaign later declined to credit it. The Local Daemon design inspection required changes for four static design findings (D161-1, D161-2a, D161-2b, D161-3), so 7505568c receives no design credit. Successor head f02f0ee9db403b6f306ab117196dc67a19df7e0b (tree f402c866), intended to address those findings, has Local source approval and retained gpt-6-astra delta-review approval with no findings, but its required CI run 39755917809 failed: in the required Live Postgres parity job the daemon did not stop within the deadline during a conformance restart, and the non-required macOS fallback E2E job failed to compile under -D warnings. No 7505568c evidence carries over, f02f0ee9 has no CI, consumer, or design credit. Residual successor 689883e2 was intended to address those CI failures, but Local's source review required changes for finding L161-6, because the auxiliary PostgreSQL release-client repair task could wait on locks outside its five-second budget; its required CI also failed. Successor 0490f5e5 was intended to address L161-6 and had retained gpt-6-astra delta-review approval, but Local's source review found that the repair's single-flight flag could still be left set if the scheduled task was dropped before it first ran. Head 745eaf28 was intended to close that gap; Local's source review and the retained gpt-6-astra delta review approved it with no findings, but its required CI run 39764752556 failed in the Live Postgres parity and Windows InstalledCurrent Postgres process-proof jobs. Head 0486beeb027ba787465a860f94eacc06a26f8170 (tree d0052264) was intended to address both failures: conformance scenarios stop the daemon before discarding the PostgreSQL schema, the InstalledCurrent profile is written once under a lock, and the drain-release connection is prepared eagerly and maintained proactively only for daemon-owned profile backends, with a bounded release per call and bounded repair; public construction and ordinary activity use one connection, although an explicit lease release can still open the release connection lazily. Local's source review and the retained gpt-6-astra delta review approved it with no findings, and its required CI run 39770808804 passed at that exact head. Watcher's fresh pre-merge attestation approved 0486beeb, but Operator Station's returned changes required (OS-PR161-0486BEE-1: the PostgreSQL consumer fixture dropped its schema before stopping its daemon). Head 4cd3493864c7c47698b5a44c853d09fa4b6dcbd1 (tree 16456905) was intended to address that finding by stopping the fixture daemon through the identity-bound stop path before the final schema drop; Local's source review and the retained gpt-6-astra delta review approved it with no findings, and its required CI run 39775306925 passed at that exact head. Fresh Watcher and Operator Station pre-merge consumer attestations approved that exact head, and Station closed OS-PR161-0486BEE-1; the formal consumer gate remains planned. The Local Daemon design inspection approved 4cd34938 and resolved D161-1, D161-2a, D161-2b, D161-3, and OS-PR161-0486BEE-1. No earlier-head evidence carries over. The campaign resolved the inspector profile by enforcing the operator's standing instruction, and a fresh gpt-6-astra, high-reasoning, long-context Application Client design inspection approved 4cd34938 with no blocking design finding. Head 5d21a63d856efbfb233a307baac840b4991affdb (tree e435edf7), two commits over 4cd34938, added an ephemeral Windows CI proof of the official v0.2.1 upgrade for E161-1 in a disposable volume-root directory, with no workstation or parent ACL change. No 4cd34938 evidence carried over; the implementer reported fresh gpt-6-astra exact-delta source and full design approvals with no findings, but CI run 39805183080 failed in two required Windows jobs: the new Released v0.2.1 upgrade proof job stopped with PSMODULEPATH failed with exit code 1, and Build and test failed the station_intent cooperative-truncation test; no cause is established beyond that output. Local's source and design reviews returned changes required for proof-script findings L161-7, L161-8, P161-1, and P161-2 (an incomplete timeout and lost timeout output, cleanup authorized before root ownership, and a failed process lookup treated as exit), and Watcher and Operator Station approved source consumability but withheld runtime credit, so 5d21a63d received no gate credit. Head 631aff225918efd63beda6e8a0f0c36280bfb323 (tree ffa38ba6), three commits over 5d21a63d, replaced that PowerShell proof with an ignored Windows test in the existing Rust InstalledCurrent harness: CI downloads and verifies official v0.2.1 and runs the test against the exact head, roots are created exclusively and owner-private, nothing is recursively deleted, ephemeral runner teardown owns the roots, and shutdown reuses the exact-generation daemon stop; production source was unchanged. Local's design inspection approved 631aff22 and found P161-1 and P161-2 structurally closed, but Local's source review, while finding L161-7, L161-8, P161-1, and P161-2 structurally closed, returned changes required for L161-9 (an early proof failure on an empty installation makes the destructor panic a second time, masking the original failure), so 631aff22 received no gate credit. Current head dacf3d181fd614875bada5dc6a02b62bcf00b5c8 (tree 5c2123ad), one commit over 631aff22, fixes L161-9 by making best-effort teardown return false without running a command when no valid current binary is selected. Local's source review and design inspection approved it with no findings, and the implementer reports fresh gpt-6-astra delta and Application Client design approvals without a supplied artifact; CI run 39810406366 completed with failure (16 of 17 jobs passed): the official v0.2.1 proof job 119934799074 passed, but required Build and test (windows-latest) job 119934799106 failed in real_process_copilot_fallback_cold_start with exit code -1073740940 (cause not inferred). Watcher and Operator Station approved source consumability but withheld runtime credit (Station blocker OS-PR161-DACF3D1-R1), so the head has no gate or readiness credit, and the implementer owns completion. The released-v0.2.1 upgrade proof is not accepted: incident I161-1 rewrote the ACL of the operator's real LocalAppData directory without a backup, and isolation certification remains withheld. On 2026-10-22 the operator directed that current host permissions and evidence be preserved while the existing owners continue a bounded read-only impact review; no restoration, permission change, proof rerun, or cleanup is authorized, and impact assessment and isolation acceptance remain open. E161-1 remains an outstanding validation obligation, and merge remains outstanding. Under a 2026-10-22 user correction, the retained implementer, supported by App, owns resolving the remaining evidence and completing the normal guarded delivery and merge flow; the campaign's E161-1 options prompt and added merge-floor certification are withdrawn, not answered or waived. One node and PR must prove all ten accepted semantic families through the public Rust surface across isolated SQLite and credentialed Postgres, include public-only Watcher send-only and Station bidirectional fixtures, repair missing shared semantics in the same PR, and provide temporary-seam replacement guidance without introducing a duplicate framework or product implementation.

nodes.title: Supported client is consumable by both product workstreams
